name: aiuic-workspace
description: AIUIC + Hepta: the layer between knowing what the user wants and the write happening.

scripts.test: for p in core resolve hepta tools compose memory brand devtools present eui kit pyramid mcp conductor orchestrators menu adapters sdk notify settings knowing tacit server devkit eval; do (cd packages/$p && npx vitest run) || exit 1; done
scripts.typecheck: for p in core resolve hepta tools compose memory brand devtools present eui kit pyramid mcp conductor orchestrators menu adapters sdk notify settings knowing tacit server devkit eval; do (cd packages/$p && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json) || exit 1; done && npx tsc -p apps/tacit/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:demo: npx esbuild demo/entry.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=AIUIC --minify --outfile=demo/aiuic.bundle.js --log-level=warning && scripts/page.sh demo page-head.html page-body.html
scripts.build:hepta: cd apps/hepta && npx esbuild src/daemon.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=hepta.mjs --log-level=warning --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:hepta && npm run build:hepta-dev && npm run build:studio && npm run build:pages
scripts.build:hepta-dev: cd apps/hepta-dev && npx esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=hepta-dev.mjs --external:playwright --log-level=warning --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" && cp ../../packages/devkit/runtime/runtime.js runtime.js
scripts.build:studio: cd apps/studio && npx esbuild entry.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=AIUIC --platform=browser --target=es2020 --minify --legal-comments=none --outfile=aiuic.bundle.js --log-level=warning && sed -e '1d' -e '$d' app.js > .app.tmp.js && npx esbuild .app.tmp.js --minify --target=es2020 --log-level=warning --outfile=.app.min.js && { cat head.html body.html; echo '<script>'; cat aiuic.bundle.js; echo '</script><script>'; cat .app.min.js; echo '</script>'; } | sed 's#(https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/issues/986)#(MCP SEP 986)#' > index.html && rm -f .app.tmp.js .app.min.js
scripts.build:pages: npm run build:demo && npm run build:heckit && npm run build:console && npm run build:stage && npm run build:orb && npm run build:docs && npm run build:tacit
scripts.build:docs: npm run build:runtime && scripts/page.sh apps/docs head.html body.html packages/devkit/runtime/runtime.js
